## 2.1.303

- Bug fixes and reliability improvements

| Change | Before | From 2.1.303 | Report as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claude mcp add-json -s user <name> '<json>'` | takes the entry JSON as an argument | reads the entry JSON from stdin only; an entry passed as an argument exits with code 2, so secrets no longer show in process lists | breaking, confirmed: `WATCH-OVERRIDE: claude mcp add-json no longer takes the entry as an argument` |
